title: Three things every agent needs in production
lede: Building it is the easy part. These keep it working after launch.

items.title: Tracing
items.text: Every decision and tool call is recorded, so you can replay what happened and why.

items.title: Evaluation
items.text: A test set runs before each release, so a better prompt doesn't quietly break something else.

items.title: Governance
items.text: Who may use which agent, what it may touch, and an audit log for every action.
